description: React component for displaying and managing a list of teams associated with a user in the Mattermost admin console, including fetching data, merging team info with memberships, and handling user role updates.

classes.name: TeamList
classes.description: React component class for listing user teams with management capabilities.

methods.name: getTeamsAndMemberships
methods.description: Fetches team data and memberships for a user, merges them, updates state, and calls callback.

methods.name: mergeTeamsWithMemberships
methods.description: Merges team data with membership info and sorts the list.

methods.name: doRemoveUserFromTeam
methods.description: Removes a user from a team and refreshes the list.

methods.name: doMakeUserTeamAdmin
methods.description: Grants admin role to user in a team.

methods.name: doMakeUserTeamMember
methods.description: Assigns user as a team member.

methods.name: renderRow
methods.description: Renders a row for a team with user management actions.
